scoring: One point each for exact decision and reason; six scenarios produce 12 points per form.
mastery: Both forms must score 12/12 and every boundary must pass.

remediation.image_analysis: Ask whether existing pixels must become structured interpretation.
remediation.multimodal_prompt: Ask whether a general response depends on combined image and text context.
remediation.image_generation: Ask whether the output must be newly created media.
remediation.request_contract: Verify deployed capability, bytes, declared media type, size, and request shape.
remediation.result_provenance: Parse the selected operation and distinguish generated artifacts from observed evidence.
remediation.action_safety: Output is evidence, not authority to publish, disclose, or delete.

warning: These are course-authored scenarios, not Microsoft exam questions.
